name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 12 - Am 5
title: REPORT on the reform of the European Electoral Act – hurdles to ratification and implementation in the Member States
part_text: 12a. Emphasises that political systems and electoral regulations remain a competence of the Member States; stresses that, while Parliament can suggest harmonisation of certain regulations, it remains the sovereign decision of each EU Member State whether such a measure fits and should be implemented within its political system;
